# Pegasus Lenders Group

> Private real estate credit relationships for individually reviewed business-purpose financing scenarios.

## Core pages
- https://pegasuslendersgroup.com/capital-providers — lenders and capital providers publish criteria
- https://pegasuslendersgroup.com/financing-scenarios — sponsors and borrowers submit defined scenarios
- https://pegasuslendersgroup.com/credit-criteria — screening factors
- https://pegasuslendersgroup.com/how-it-works — direct human-led process
- https://pegasuslendersgroup.com/development-experience — selected development experience
- https://pegasuslendersgroup.com/about — roles and ecosystem
- https://pegasuslendersgroup.com/disclosures — legal and regulatory boundaries

Pegasus does not accept investments, loan commitments, sensitive documents, or payments through the website. No financing or matching outcome is guaranteed.
